description: Read the Hedera network through its public mirror node: account balances, tokens, NFTs, allowances and staking rewards, transactions, token details and holders, NFT ownership and history, Consensus Service topic messages, smart contracts and their calls, the HBAR exchange rate and supply, and the network's nodes, on Mainnet or Testnet. Start a workflow when an account has a new transaction or a topic gets a new message. No account or API key required.

hedera_new_topic_message_trigger.description: Runs when a new message is sent to a Hedera Consensus Service topic, with the message decoded to text.

output.chunk_number: For a message sent in parts: which part this is.
output.chunk_total: For a message sent in parts: how many parts.
output.consensus_at: The same moment, ISO 8601 in UTC.
output.message: The message as text. Empty when it is not text, such as an encrypted or binary message.
output.message_base64: The message exactly as sent, base64 encoded.
output.payer_account_id: The account that paid to send it.
output.running_hash: The topic's running hash after this message.
output.sequence_number: The message's number in its topic: 1 for the first.
output.topic_id: The topic the message was sent to.

hedera_new_transaction_trigger.description: Runs when a Hedera account takes part in a new transaction, with every HBAR, token and NFT movement in it. Optionally only money in or out, one kind of transaction, or one outcome.

output.consensus_at: The same moment, ISO 8601 in UTC.
output.consensus_timestamp: When the network agreed on it, in the mirror node's seconds.nanoseconds form. Unique to this transaction.
output.direction: received, sent or both, as the account saw it (HBAR net of the fee it paid, tokens and NFTs by side); empty when it only paid a fee.
output.entity_id: The account, token, topic, contract or file it created or acted on, if any.
output.hbar_change: The account's net HBAR change in the transaction, fees included.
output.memo: The transaction's memo, if it has one.
output.nft_transfers: Every NFT moved, minted or burned.
output.payer_account_id: The account that paid for it.
output.result: The outcome, e.g. SUCCESS or INSUFFICIENT_PAYER_BALANCE.
output.scheduled: True when it ran from a schedule.
output.staking_reward_transfers: Staking rewards paid out with this transaction.
output.type: The kind of transaction, e.g. CRYPTOTRANSFER or TOKENMINT.
output.type_label: The kind in words, e.g. 'Transfer' or 'Mint token'.
